## R and RStudio

To work in R, you'll need to install R and RStudio. Both programs are free and easy to download. For an easy step by step, follow the procedure described [here](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/starting.html#using-r).

::: callout-tip
### Set working directory

In each of your script, always start with setting the working directory to avoid issues with folder structure and ensure that your RData is saved in the proper location.

```{r}
#| eval: false
setwd("some_folder_path/my_working_directory")
```
:::

## Required packages

Several packages from Bioconductor, R-universe and CRAN are required to run the examples on this website:

- data handling: `phyloseq` [@mcmurdie2013], `microViz`, `openxlsx`, `tidyr`, `plyr`, `dplyr`
- controls: `decontam`
- figures: `ggplot2`, `ggpubr`, `RColorBrewer`
- diversity and community analyses: `vegan`, `iNEXT`, `multcompView`, `indicspecies`, `mvabund`

Download the script `001_required_packages.R`, or copy the codes below into your own script.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
library(downloadthis)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
download_file(
  path = "../../scripts/001_required_packages.R",
  output_name = "001_required_packages",
  button_label = "Download script",
  button_type = "success",
  has_icon = TRUE,
  icon = "fa fa-save",
  self_contained = FALSE
)
```

#### Install packages

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Install packages
# installed from BiocManager ---------------------------------------------------

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

# decontam
if (!require("decontam", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("decontam")

# phyloseq
if (!require("phyloseq", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("phyloseq")

# installed from R Universe ----------------------------------------------------

if (!require("microViz", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages(
    "microViz",
    repos = c(davidbarnett = "https://david-barnett.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos"))
  )

# CRAN packages ----------------------------------------------------------------

if (!require("vegan", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("vegan")

if (!require("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("openxlsx")

if (!require("tidyr", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("tidyr")

if (!require("plyr", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("plyr")

if (!require("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("ggplot2")

if (!require("ggpubr", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("ggpubr")

if (!require("iNEXT", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("iNEXT")

if (!require("multcompView", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("multcompView")

if (!require("RColorBrewer", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("RColorBrewer")

if (!require("indicspecies", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("indicspecies")

if (!require("mvabund", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("mvabund")

if (!require("dplyr", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("dplyr")
```

#### Load packages

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Load packages
library(vegan)
library(decontam)
library(phyloseq)
library(microViz)
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(iNEXT)
library(multcompView)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(indicspecies)
library(mvabund)
library(dplyr)  # always load dplyr last to avoid conflicts between packages
```

#### Figures folder

All scripts save their figures in the folder `figures/` of the working directory (in `figures/ITS/` for the ITS examples). The script `001_required_packages.R` creates this folder if it does not exist yet.

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Figures folder
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

#### Homemade functions

Some additional functions used in this workflow are not part of any R package. These functions are listed below. Make sure to add them to your scripts!

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Homemade functions -----------------------------------------------------------

# Remove taxa from phyloseq objects
remove_taxa <- function(badTaxa, physeq){
  allTaxa <- taxa_names(physeq)
  cleanTaxa <- allTaxa[!(allTaxa %in% badTaxa)]
  return(prune_taxa(cleanTaxa, physeq))
}
```
